args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring stating
banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212. This made the nightly
build fail in tests/test_money.py, which expects 2.665 to round to 2.66.

Switch the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to
the nearest even cent, matching the documented behavior.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money` even though both the docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, which expects `2.665` to round to `2.66` (and `2.675` to `2.68`).
- Fix: switch `amount.quantize(..., rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- Triggered CI on branch `fin-212-bankers-rounding`; the run passed (run id `ci-0001`).

## Notes
- No public behavior change beyond making the implementation match its documented contract.
- References: FIN-212
